# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers on Corsat Station, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it, and the Company censor reads it before we do. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO SWAP[/bold], Sigma residential module, for anything in Gamma. Tired of the monorail. Ask for the night custodian. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], a quiet bunk away from the researcher quarters, one season only. Visiting scientist, will not talk about work and asks the same of you. - Official allocations are posted at [netlink="Station housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]HYDROPONICS HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the Theta east and west wings. Early starts, wet boots, fresh greens to take home. - [bold]MONORAIL TECHNICIAN[/bold] sought for track and brake checks between Gamma and Sigma. Must hold a checkpoint pass.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]WARM COAT[/bold], bought for a stint in the Theta snow terrarium, worn twice. Trade for real coffee. - [bold]CHESS SET[/bold], one white bishop carved from a canteen spoon. Sold as is.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: blue lanyard with a Gamma access card, somewhere near the arcade. Security already knows. Please return it anyway. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a child's drawing of three domes and a train, left in the library. Collect it at the press office.
## Notices - Families of the cell block guards meet in the Gamma canteen after the last shift change on rest days. Bring your own mug.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page. In an emergency, follow the [netlink="Administration emergency notices" link="admin.colony.gov/emergency"].
